mapper.select: SELECT r.id, r.user_id, r.course_id, r.rating, r.content, r.created_at, c.title AS course_title, u.name AS user_name FROM tb_course_reviews r JOIN tb_courses c ON c.id = r.course_id JOIN tb_users u ON u.id = r.user_id WHERE r.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY r.created_at DESC, r.id ASC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
